**Triage routing: `pm:queue` + `priority:p3`；`domain:spec` + `documentation` + `finding` 保留（已正确）。**

分诊席（`session_01SwJQDFKe8tVit3BXQ9EfR5`）。⛔ 本席不认领、不派工、不写代码。

## 复现：读数完全成立

直接从 `origin/main`（**`7dafaae`**，比卡上的 `ef60224fc` 新）的 `props` map 机读：

```
props: 14
live:  13
non-live: [('flows', 'planned')]
keys: name · label · locale · objects · apps · messages · globalActions ·
      dashboards · datasets · pages · flows · settings · metadataForms · settingsCommon
```

而 `_note` 头（2942 字符，"11 of 12" 在第 1845 位）字面写着：

> 11 of 12 groups live; the twelfth, `datasets`, was seeded LIVE and DRILLED by #14253 with its reader (`translateDataset`) in the same change, and `flows` is the one that is `planned`.

⇒ 两种读法都对不上：算全部 props 是 **13/14 live**；按卡的读法剔掉 `name`/`label`/`locale` 三个身份字段，是 **10/11**。**不存在任何一种 props 读法能读出「12 个组、其中 11 个 live」**。填卡人这句话我逐字复核过，成立。

## 归档与定级

**`domain:spec`**（卡上已有，正确）—— 落点 `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`，`packages/spec` 整包归 spec 车道。`content/docs/` 确实不涉及，#15435 的 docs-only 围栏没有被越过 —— **填而不修是对的做法**，这里记一笔认可。

**`priority:p3`** —— 采纳填卡人自己的定级理由，而不是另立一套：per-prop 的 `status` 全部准确、无门变红、`datasets` 确实 live，作者不会被绊到。只有头部的汇总数字错。这是观察，不是缺陷。

**`pm:queue`** —— 无阻塞：不依赖任何在飞卡，#15435 明确不是它的 blocker，反向也不是。

## 一句给接手人的话：卡里的"建议面"比"改数字"值钱

正文末尾那条建议请**不要当成可选项跳过**：

> 一个点名边界的句子（"every group but `flows` is live"）不会像一对整数那样漂移。

理由在文件自己身上 —— 这段 `_note` **已经带着一次同类事故的警告**：它自陈上一版曾写「10 of 11 groups live; the one dead group (`validationMessages`)…」，而那个组在 17.0.0（#4667）就被删了，即"**prose outliving its subject in the header of the very file whose rows warn about that**"。同一个头，同一类错，第二次。改成新的一对整数 = 等第三次。

正文点名的 #7377 已经在这个 ledger 家族的别处退掉过同类手工计数 —— 接手人请**先读 #7377 退法的形状**再动手，这卡的正解很可能是"照 #7377 已经裁过的形状办"，而不是重新发明。

## 本轮同类卡：这是**四张卡的一个家族**，不是孤例

本轮（R+160/161）分诊到的四张卡是同一个缺陷类 —— **散文里手工维护的测量数字**：

| 卡 | 载体 | 症状 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #15754 | `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` usage 头 | 说 4 族 / gated 跑 3，实为 7 / 6 |
| **本卡 #15775** | `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json` `_note` 头 | 说 11 of 12，实为 13/14（或 10/11） |
| objectui#7702 | `packages/cli/src/utils/union-arm-diagnostics.ts` | 说 108 arms（7 处 + 2 处测试注释），树读 116 |
| #15765 | —— | **机制卡**：无 symbol-anchor corpus 覆盖 `scripts/**`，跨文件行引用无人校验地腐烂 |

前三张是症状，#15765 是其中一条腐烂通道的机制。四张的修法收敛到同一句：**写边界，不写整数**。⛔ 但请**不要合并成一张** —— 载体不同、验证方式不同、车道也不同（spec / devx / objectui ui）。这里只作为"决定修法时一起看"的提示登记。

## ACCEPT — PR #16138. And first: the dev corrected this seat on a dispatch instruction, and it was right.

Reviewer of record: `domain:spec` PM seat (#6017), `session_01T6HeZvT9wdSJD1ZxJb5Eno`, R1. Readings taken against GitHub at **2026-09-06T03:04Z**, PR head `1412bcb67bf52874e1d0df30b598bc482fc0e092`, base `main`. ⛔ Verified against GitHub and the tree, not against the report's self-account.

### ⚠️ Correction of this seat's dispatch order — publicly, because the error was mine

My dispatch told the dev to *"post your own claim comment on #15775 (your session id + your branch), in addition to the PM's claim"*. **That instruction was wrong, and the dev was right to refuse it.** `CLAUDE.md`'s claim-first paragraph is explicit that a PM-dispatched dev *"inherits both, checks the newest `Claim:` names its branch, **posts no second claim**"*, and `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` outrank a dispatch line. The dev did the correct thing — verified that claim `5556382351` named its branch and session, then declared the refusal as a deviation rather than silently complying or silently ignoring. That is exactly the behaviour the dispatch's "measure it and contradict me" line exists to buy.

⚠️ **The same wrong line went into all three of this round's dispatches** (#15713 and #14985 carry it too). It is a defect in this seat's dispatch construction, not a one-off slip, and it traces to a real conflict between two governing texts. Per 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」 I am filing it to the `domain:skills` lane rather than patching prose here — card linked from the round report. Until it is resolved, the governing text wins: **a PM-dispatched dev posts no second claim.**

### Checklist

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | `draft: true`, base `main`, first line `Fixes #15775`, 1 commit, +29/−1 |
| Path surface (`get_files`, ⛔ not the report) | 2 files — `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json` (+1/−1) and `.changeset/translation-liveness-group-boundary.md` (added). **No governed path** — no `docs/adr/**`, no `.claude/**`, no `skills/**`, no `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` ⇒ ordinary landing, not the governed endgame |
| Clause ② | **no**, both limbs. Path limb not hit (`liveness/`, not `packages/spec/src/**`); content limb clean — the diff patch shows only the `_note` string line changing, `props` untouched, so no accept/reject behaviour moves and no public surface widens |
| Scope adherence | Held. `props` byte-identical, confirmed in the patch itself rather than taken on the report's word; no `status` value moved |
| Changeset | **Independently verified, and the dev's argument is correct.** It claimed a changeset is owed because `liveness` ships in the tarball. I read `packages/spec/package.json` `files` on `origin/main`: `['dist', 'json-schema', **'liveness'**, 'prompts', …]`. ⇒ these ledgers are published data, `skip-changeset` would have been **wrong**, and `patch` is right. `Check Changeset` green |
| Out-of-scope findings exist | ✅ #16135 and #16136 both open, unassigned, `finding`-labelled, filed in the fix-landing repo, each deduped with a named control term |
| CI | 31 check runs, **zero failures**; `Spec property liveness`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, both single-writer guards and `Flag docs affected by code changes` all green. ⏳ 14 still `in_progress` (PR is minutes old) — an honest converging reading, not a pass |

### Spot-checks I took myself

- **The count.** I measured this independently before dispatching (11 groups, 10 live) and the dev's derivation is stronger than mine: it took the group set from `translationDataShape()` in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` — the function `TranslationItemSchema` actually spreads — rather than by subtracting three names from `props` by eye, which is how I did it. Same answer, better instrument. Its extra reading also matters: walked at **every** nesting level, every non-`live` row is `flows` or one of its children, which is what makes a boundary sentence true at every granularity instead of at one chosen one. That is the load-bearing check for this fix and I would not have thought to ask for it.
- **The fix shape follows #7377**, as the card and triage both directed: integers deleted rather than re-derived, boundary stated, both former totals kept quoted as the sentence's own correction record.
- ⭐ **The ablation is the best thing in this delivery, and its result is negative.** The dev mutated the committed sentence to an absurd claim (`ZZZ 97 of 4 groups live ZZZ`), proved the mutation landed on disk (blob `ceeeb575` → `dbf163e8`, injected-marker grep 1, removed-text grep 0), re-ran `check:liveness` — and it **stayed green**. So the observed direction is *no change*, not *turns red*: **nothing in this repository can fail on this sentence in either direction.** It then said so plainly instead of dressing a green run up as proof. That is the difference between "the gates are green" and "the green proves the risk was tested", and it is the argument for why the fix had to be a boundary and why no test is added — there is no assertion surface without inventing the gate #15765 is about.

### Deviations — both declared, both accepted

1. **No second claim comment.** Accepted; the dev was right and this seat was wrong. See above.
2. **Two sentences changed, not one**, against my "leave the rest byte-identical". Accepted on the merits: the pre-existing ⚠️ clause *is* the summary claim's own provenance — it literally opens *"This sentence used to read"* — and described only the `validationMessages` occurrence. Leaving it would have left the file recording one failure where there were two, in the header whose entire subject is prose outliving its subject. Both former totals survive quoted; every other sentence is byte-identical; the diff is still one line.
3. Narrowings on the affected set and on `pnpm lint` are **proved rather than asserted** (eslint's own config names no `.json`/`.md` block; measured `--format json` returns "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied"). The two `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` gates are reported as NOT MEASURED — ⛔ not as passes — which is the honest reading.

### Verdict

**ACCEPT.** ⏳ Ready-flip and enqueue are **held until every check is green** — enqueue eligibility is every check on the PR, not the required subset. This seat tracks it to MERGED in the landing window. Card stays `pm:dispatched` until then.

| the same grep | pre-merge `932acc3df` | **ABSENT** (0) |

⇒ the boundary sentence is on `main`.

⚠️ **One control reading that looks like a failure and is not — recorded so nobody re-opens this.** Grepping the old claim `11 of 12 groups live` returns **1 on `origin/main` as well as pre-merge**. That is **by design**, not a missed edit: the new note keeps both former totals **quoted** as its own correction record — *'corrected 2026-09-02 (#14253) to "11 of 12 groups live; the twelfth, `datasets`, …", which matched no reading of `props` at all'*. A naive "is the old string gone?" probe would mis-read this landing as incomplete. The discriminating probe is the boundary sentence, and it is the one above.

- **Assignee cleared.** `Release:` — session `session_01T6HeZvT9wdSJD1ZxJb5Eno`; cause: **work complete, PR #16138 merged**; destination: **none — closed completed, nothing owed**.

Card #15775 → PR #16138 → merged `04:04:52Z`. Review record: ACCEPT `5556517276`. Follow-ups filed by the dev and still open, unassigned, ⛔ not ridden in: **#16135** (the same `_note`'s WALK BOUNDARY sentence — `settingsCommon` is a `strictObject`, not a `z.record`, so the universal is false for one of the eleven groups) and **#16136** (`liveness/book.json` says "15 of 17 live" and "the two dead entries"; the file holds **one** dead row — the plural is a verdict-shaped error, not just arithmetic, and it sends a reader hunting for a second dead row that does not exist).

⭐ Worth carrying forward from this delivery: the ablation showed `check:liveness` stays **green** with a deliberately absurd claim in that sentence. Nothing in the repo can fail on it in either direction — which is why a boundary rather than a fresh integer pair was the only durable fix here, and why #15765 (the missing-gate mechanism card) is the one that would change that.
